reason: Integrates cc-switch with DSH by importing supported provider profiles into DSH model routes through CLI, startup synchronization, slash commands, or an agent tool.

summaries.zh: 将 cc-switch 中受支持的供应商配置同步为 DSH 模型路由，支持命令行、启动同步、斜杠命令和智能体工具。
summaries.en: Syncs supported cc-switch provider profiles into DSH model routes through the CLI, startup synchronization, slash command, or agent tool.

capabilities: Reads the local cc-switch SQLite database in read-only mode
Synchronizes supported provider profiles into DSH model routes
Writes route configuration through the DSH settings interface
Stores credential references for imported API keys
Exposes synchronization through a CLI, startup hook, slash command, and agent tool
